name: theme-base
title: JHAI Theme Base
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The structural tokens this component set needs: a type scale, spacing rhythm, control heights, durations and measure caps, all prefixed --ui- so they cannot collide with your own. Colour is NOT here — components paint in shadcn semantics only, so your palette is already the palette. Install this first; every other @jhai item assumes it.
